title: Urbanstrive Cheese Grater With Container Box Grater Stainless Steel Graters for Kitchen Cheese Shredder Parmesan Shredder Kitchen Gadgets Kitchen Tools Kitchen Gifts for Chef Dishwasher Safe Zester
description:
About this item
Durable Sharp, 304 Stainless Steel - Made of 304 stainless steel (95%), the heavy-duty cheese graters provide rugged strength and long-lasting performance
Box Gratters with Sharp Blades on 4 Sides - Coarse, medium, and fine grating surfaces, and slicing surface. Sharp stainless-steel shredding holes on 4 sides allow for efficient grating of a variety of foods, including cheese, vegetables, chocolate, and more
Vegetable Grater with Ergonomic Comfortable Handle - the comfortable non-slip handle provides a safe, secure grip and ultimate control
Non-slip Base & Detachable Container - Black TPE material (5%) on the base helps keep the grater securely in place while in use. Attachable container for catching, measuring, and storing freshly grated foods
Multipurpose Versatility - The grater works well for grating cheese and hard or soft vegetables, like cucumbers, cabbage, carrots, onions, potatoes, zucchini, and more. Dishwasher-safe for quick cleanup

reviews_5s: Haven't used it yet, but it looks exactly like the picture. I like the fact it comes with four different sizes for grating from very tine ( maybe to zest a lemon) to quite large. And I like that it has a closed bottom so what I grate stays put until I'm ready to release it.Easy to use, and love the container underneath that holds the cheese, so it doesn’t go everywhere. I had an old rusted one and like this NEW one that has a soft handle which helps cushion my wrist. I'm one that grates my own cheese for immediate freshness and this does that and cuts/slices my vegetables as well. The container with lid fits on the end and can store away as one unit, so I don’t have to try to find the attachment :)It seems excessive to say I love a cheese grater, but honestly, I love this one. I bought it to rice cauliflower, and the little catcher cup in the bottom is a genius idea. It's easy to clean, store, and use, and I haven't even cut myself yet. Definitely love this design!I absolutely love this shredder! I have shredded cheeses and vegetables for years, but this one makes it easy to measure and store what I shred. To sweeten the deal, it's my favorite color and the container can be turned around to store inside the shredder to save space! This was a wonderful purchase!Great cheese grater! Exactly what I needed. And it comes with a container that catches the cheese and has a lid - so if there is any leftover, you can just put it in the fridge!This is such a convenience in the kitchen the clear container that attaches to the greater comes to the lid that allows me to store the grated cheese. Is there any other way? The greater is sturdy, the greater blades work well, and it’s very grippy easy to hold onto. I’m very good purchase in my opinion.The very best grater I've ever owned and it's got a measuring cup and rubber feet to avoid sliding around well engineered and great product it's come in handy for various needs already.This set is great, easy to use and store. The grater is strong and the handle works great. I love the storage container this comes with! Has a lid too. Cheaper here than Walmart!This grater works very well and quickly grates a large wedge of cheese or a quantity of vegetables. Comes out of the dishwasher looking brand new. I wish I gotten it a long time ago instead of struggling with my old one!This is by far the coolest grater. I love that it comes with a container you can attach and you can grate it right there and then and close it up.
reviews_1s:
I think this may be my first and only 1-start review. I really hate this thing.

For $10 I decided to roll the dice on this grater because surely it should be able to out perform my 17-year old grater, right? WRONG! This thing...just sucks at its job. I only tired the large holes twice using fridge-temperature cheddar and found myself laughing at how incredibly dull the cutting edges were and the ridiculous spacing between the perforations. All of the stupid flat surfaces did a great job in providing friction and heat to the cheese, but cutting?
Nahhhh, let's not worry about that. Having shredded half the block I whipped out our original grater and...just gained a whole new appreciation for the old workhorse. On top of it, this thing is SMALL. DON'T BE DUPED - THE LITTLE PLASTIC COLLECTION BASIN IS NOTHING MORE THAN A COST SAVINGS ON THE STEEL. It's there so you can still shred a whole 4oz. block while not having to retain the full 4oz. volume in the steel grater.

TOTAL JUNK. DO NOT RECOMMEND. DO NOT BUY. DON'T INSULT YOUR CHEESE WITH THIS LOW-COST ABOMINATION.Was so excited to used this to make orange scones and with first use the top has already broken off. Also used time smaller hole for orange zest and the plastic collector for the zest stained and it appears that the plastic was “scarred” by the acid in the zest? Never seen that before. Beyond the dents, it works great.Unpacked it, thought it looked nice and liked the container to collect whatever your grating. First use was grating a block of Tillamook cheese when the handle popped off resulting in my thumb getting gashed open on the backside grates leaving blood everywhere.
